lessons.trigger_condition: a mutating autonomy cycle could pass verified neural and transactional safety gates while peer learning summaries were missing, conflicting, or malformed without an explicit information-exchange governance decision
lessons.prevention_rule: V378 must validate the 100-senior preparation and 25x40=1000 review-cell policy before mutation; parse only strict summary-only peer learning envelopes; fail closed before V377 on malformed or conflicting exchange evidence; require independent local reproduction for single-system evidence; admit only corroborated summaries as bounded advisory council signals; never auto-apply peer fixes or promote facts, trust, prices, grades, or market direction; keep runtime self-extension allowlisted and source-level changes behind protected PR/CI
validation_required: functional candidate commit is exactly f4c81ab5901d9d7a9dc296ce5fb53b40348d3554
tablet runtime manifest includes tablet_autonomous_evolution_v378.py while preserving v377 and v376
mutating V378 cycles fail closed before V377 when the 100+1000 policy is invalid
malformed or conflicting information exchange fails closed before V377 mutation
single-system peer evidence requires independent local reproduction and cannot auto-apply a peer fix
corroborated peer summaries may enter the advisory council only as validated summary signals
peer exchange never shares raw state or auto-promotes facts trust prices grades or market direction
100 senior preparation perspectives and 1000 expert review cells are validated as a simulated internal quality framework, not external human participation
verified query job repair meta skill and validated exchange signals remain advisory and cannot bypass core history resource pending-trial or verification gates
market adaptation uses freshness regional coverage and source health only and never infers market direction
runtime self-added behavior remains allowlisted declarative capabilities only
source-level feature gaps remain non-executable proposals requiring protected branch PR CI and full regression
V377 single-run lock and V376 evidence barrier execution journal verified learning and ambiguous-retry protections remain preserved
physical Tablet runtime and Drive readback remain unverified until matching external evidence exists
lessons.safety_boundary: V378 expands bounded decision governance, validated information-exchange management, and verified feedback coordination only; it does not create arbitrary source code or commands, write Git/main, copy peer fixes automatically, weaken verification, invent market direction/facts/prices/grades, or claim literal 100/1000 external reviewers
